Create a flag rule

Source: R/classes.R
new_flag_rule.Rd

Convenience constructor for FlagRule objects.

Usage

new_flag_rule(
  id,
  domain,
  severity = "warning",
  category = "quality",
  owner_team = "Biostats",
  fn
)

Arguments

id

Rule identifier.

domain

Target domain name in an artifact.

severity

Severity label (for example, "warning", "critical").

category

Rule category label.

owner_team

Team that owns follow-up.

fn

Function that accepts a domain data.frame and returns a data.frame of flagged rows.

Value

A validated FlagRule object.

Examples

rule <- new_flag_rule(
  id = "HI_SYSBP",
  domain = "ADVS",
  fn = function(df) {
    out <- df[df$PARAMCD == "SYSBP" & df$AVAL > 180, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(out)) return(data.frame())
    out[, c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVAL"), drop = FALSE]
  }
)
